apidocs.info.description:
This API is called from the servers of services integrated with ChreeID.

## Authentication

The server-to-server API (`/api/v1/*`) authenticates with the ID and secret of a client registered in the admin console. Send them either with HTTP Basic authentication or as the form fields `client_id` / `client_secret`.

Only confidential clients allowed to provision accounts (`can_provision`) may call it.

## Errors

On failure, the response uses the same shape as OAuth 2.0 along with the HTTP status. Validation errors (422) also include per-field reasons in `errors`.

```json
{ "error": "invalid_client", "error_description": "Client authentication failed" }
```

Descriptions are returned in the language of `Accept-Language`. Always branch on `error`.

apidocs.token.description: Exchanges an authorization code for an ID token and an access token. If a used code arrives again, every token issued from that code is revoked.
apidocs.token.id_token: A JWT signed with RS256. Verify it with the public keys at /oauth/jwks
apidocs.token.invalid: The code is invalid or expired, or redirect_uri or code_verifier does not match
apidocs.token.summary: Exchange an authorization code for tokens
apidocs.userinfo.description: Returns only the claims within the scope of the access token.
apidocs.userinfo.invalid: The token is missing, invalid, or revoked
apidocs.verify_password.description: Verifies what was entered in the service's sign-in form against ChreeID. Only users linked to the calling client can be verified.
apidocs.verify_password.invalid: Wrong address or password, or client authentication failed. Which one is wrong is not disclosed
apidocs.verify_password.status: ok means the user may be signed in. second_factor_required means two-factor authentication is needed, so send the user to the OIDC sign-in
